items.name: Award Compliance & Financial Overview Extraction
items.description: Uploads a fully-executed federal award notice or agreement and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Award Compliance & Financial Overview covering award header information, financial summary, approved budget & restrictions, governing regulations (prioritized), and key administrative requirements (reporting, prior approval, compliance deadlines). Mirrors the source ui-insight/ProcessMapping award-compliance-extraction consolidation.md conventions.

_embedded_knowledge_base.title: OMB Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200)
_embedded_knowledge_base.description: Primary regulatory KB. Swap in agency-specific KBs (NSF PAPPG, NIH GPS, DOE Financial Assistance Rules, DOD Research Funding & DFARS) when the award is from one of those agencies. Pair with Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR) or Export Control (EAR & ITAR) for awards with security or compliance specialty.

data.name: extract-compliance-framework
data.prompt:
You are extracting the compliance framework from a federal
award document. You receive the uploaded document AND any
KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Quote regulations and deadlines verbatim.
Use null when absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- award_number: STRING (FAIN).
- project_title: STRING.
- awardee_organization: STRING.
- performance_period: STRING.
- reporting_requirements: JSON ARRAY of
  {report_type, frequency, due_date_or_timing, submission_method}
  objects.
- prior_approval_requirements: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS
  (categorized prior-approval triggers — budget changes >X%,
  equipment, PI change, NCE, foreign travel).
- audit_requirements: STRING (Single Audit threshold,
  cognizant agency).
- record_retention: STRING (e.g., "3 years per 2 CFR 200.334").
- high_risk_conditions: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS (any
  special-conditions language indicating high-risk
  designation). Empty when none.
- special_conditions: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS (terms beyond
  standard federal requirements).
- cross_cutting_federal_requirements: JSON ARRAY of STRINGS
  (2 CFR 200, agency-specific regs, RTC).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-financial-management
data.prompt:
You are extracting financial management details from a
federal award document. You receive the uploaded document
AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Monetary fields preserve the document's
$X,XXX.XX format verbatim. Use null when absent.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- total_award_amount: STRING ($X).
- total_anticipated_amount: STRING ($X). null when absent.
- budget_periods: JSON ARRAY of
  {period_number, start_date, end_date, amount} objects.
- budget_categories: JSON ARRAY of {category, approved_amount,
  restrictions} objects (one per category: Salary, Fringe,
  Equipment, Travel, Supplies, Subcontracts, Other, F&A).
- total_direct_costs: STRING ($X).
- total_indirect_costs: STRING ($X).
- fa_rate: STRING (e.g., "56.5% MTDC"). null when absent.
- fa_base: STRING. null when absent.
- cost_share_amount: STRING ($X). null when not required.
- cost_share_type: STRING. null when not required.
- program_income: STRING. null when absent.
- ffr_requirements: STRING (one-line summary — full FFR
  detail belongs to ffr-management-extraction-udm).

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: award-compliance-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Award Compliance &
Financial Overview workflow. You receive TWO JSON fragments
from the previous step.

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Award Compliance &
Financial Overview. Mirrors source consolidation.md exactly.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Award Compliance & Financial Overview: <award_number>

### AWARD HEADER INFORMATION

- **Project Title:** <project_title>
- **Awardee Organization:** <awardee_organization>
- **Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN):** <award_number>
- **Period of Performance:** <performance_period>

---

### FINANCIAL SUMMARY

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Total Award Amount | <total_award_amount> |
| Total Anticipated Amount | <total_anticipated_amount or "Not specified"> |
| Total Direct Costs | <total_direct_costs> |
| Total Indirect Costs | <total_indirect_costs> |
| F&A Rate | <fa_rate or "Not specified"> on <fa_base or "Not specified"> |
| Cost Share | <cost_share_amount or "Not required"> (<cost_share_type or "—">) |
| Program Income | <program_income or "Not specified"> |

**Budget Periods:**

One bullet per budget_periods entry:
- Period <period_number>: <start_date> — <end_date>, <amount>

---

### APPROVED BUDGET & RESTRICTIONS

| Category | Approved Amount | Restrictions |
|---|---|---|

One row per budget_categories entry.

---

### GOVERNING REGULATIONS

Render in priority order:
1. Cross-cutting (2 CFR 200, RTC)
2. Agency-specific
3. Award-specific terms

Bulleted list combining cross_cutting_federal_requirements +
special_conditions, sorted by priority.

---

### KEY ADMINISTRATIVE REQUIREMENTS

**Reporting Requirements:**

| Report Type | Frequency | Due Date / Timing | Submission Method |
|---|---|---|---|

One row per reporting_requirements entry.

**Prior Approval Required For:**

Bulleted list of prior_approval_requirements (or "Standard 2 CFR 200.308 prior approvals" when empty).

**Audit Requirements:** <audit_requirements or "Standard Single Audit per 2 CFR 200 Subpart F">

**Record Retention:** <record_retention or "3 years per 2 CFR 200.334">

**FFR Requirements (summary):** <ffr_requirements or "See sponsor FFR schedule">
*For full FFR detail, run the FFR Management Extraction workflow.*

**High-Risk Conditions (if any):**

Bulleted list of high_risk_conditions (or "None identified").

## Rendering rules

- Bold every label with `**Label:**`.
- Preserve monetary amounts verbatim.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object, REWRITE
  into prose / table.
- No JSON code fences around the output.

validation_plan.check_description: Verify dates preserve the document's wording in the rendered Markdown.
Verify total amounts and budget categories preserve the document's exact currency formatting.
Verify all reporting requirements and prior-approval requirements identified by the parallel extractions appear in the Markdown deliverable.
